title: Reorder List
description:
You are given the head of a singly linked list represented as:

`L0 -> L1 -> ... -> L(n-1) -> Ln`

Reorder the list in-place to take the following form:

`L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> L(n-1) -> L2 -> L(n-2) -> ...`

Modify the linked list in-place by re-linking the nodes directly (do not return a new list; the judge inspects the list starting at `head`).
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 5 * 10^4].
hints: Split the linked list into two halves using slow and fast pointers so the first half has either the same length or one more node than the second half.
Reverse the second half of the linked list in-place.
Merge the first half and the reversed second half by alternating nodes from each half.

examples.explanation: Interleaving the first half [1, 2] with the reversed second half [4, 3] yields [1, 4, 2, 3].
Interleaving [1, 2, 3] with the reversed second half [5, 4] yields [1, 5, 2, 4, 3].
